invariants.text: Original source dataset files must remain unmodified after every pipeline run.
Campaign facts and campaign rules are the only sources of product truth for automated fact and policy checks.

decisions.title: One Genesis task per pipeline stage
decisions.text: Implementation work is split so each of the ten pipeline stages is its own bounded Genesis task with its own module, tests, file scope, dependencies, and executable gate. Orchestrator and export gates come after the stage modules exist. Do not collapse stages into a single implement-everything task.

decisions.title: Separate generic cleaning from Quillmint rules
decisions.text: JSON parsing, schema, normalization, and ID checks stay generic. Quillmint product facts and sales policies stay in configuration, not hard-coded stage branches.

decisions.title: No auto-delete of suspected duplicates or truncated history
decisions.text: Potential duplicates are reported, not deleted without documented handling. Truncated history is flagged and kept unless another rule excludes the record.

decisions.title: config.yaml uses JSON syntax
decisions.text: config.yaml holds Quillmint check settings (fact_checks and quality_checks) written in JSON syntax, a YAML subset, so stdlib json parses it without adding PyYAML (NFR-3). Product truth still comes only from each record's campaign.facts/rules. Quality keys live here too because config.yaml is only in T-FACT file scope.

knowledge.title: Pipeline ADR is the source architecture
knowledge.text: adr/adr01_pipeline_decision.md defines a 10-stage modular cleaning pipeline from raw sales-reply JSON/JSONL to golden train/validation/test exports. Clean data is not golden data. Golden records must be structurally valid, factually grounded, contextually correct, policy-compliant, and reviewed.

knowledge.title: Showcase dataset schema and planted errors
knowledge.text: showcase/README.md and showcase/candidates-readable.json define a fully synthetic Quillmint sales-reply dataset: 81 records, 28 threads, 26 prospects, thread-level splits (train 64, validation 8, test 9). Campaign facts and rules are the only allowed product truth. Ten unlabeled planted mistakes exist for labelers.

knowledge.title: Review CSV exported; T-SPLIT paused for Deepika
knowledge.text: On 2026-10-28 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pipeline.pipeline wrote data/review/review_queue.csv (82 rows: 6 factual_error, 4 policy_violation, 1 duplicate, 3 needs_review, 68 correct) and reports/metrics.json. T-SPLIT and T-EXPORT must not start until Deepika returns the CSV with reviewer_label/reviewer_correction/reviewer_rationale filled. Note: reports/metrics.json was written while T-SPLIT was active and reports/ is outside T-SPLIT scope; check scope before completing T-SPLIT.

knowledge.title: Validation split has no error examples
knowledge.text: After Deepika's review, golden_validation.jsonl has 8 records, all labeled correct; the source thread split placed no planted mistakes in validation. Validation cannot measure error detection. Fixing it means a thread-level re-split, which changes FR-9 and needs spec approval.
